import pytest
from httpie.core import decode_raw_args


def test_decode_raw_args_with_bytes_and_str():
    """Bytes arguments are decoded using the provided encoding."""
    args = [b"hello", "world", b"foo"]
    decoded = decode_raw_args(args, "utf-8")
    assert decoded == ["hello", "world", "foo"]


def test_decode_raw_args_with_mixed_types_and_encoding():
    """Mixed types preserve strings and decode bytes correctly."""
    args = [b"äöü", "test", b"123"]
    decoded = decode_raw_args(args, "latin-1")
    assert decoded == ["äöü", "test", "123"]


def test_decode_raw_args_invalid_bytes_raises():
    """Decoding bytes with an incompatible encoding raises UnicodeDecodeError."""
    args = [b"\xff\xfe\xfa"]
    with pytest.raises(UnicodeDecodeError):
        decode_raw_args(args, "utf-8")
